verdict.rationale: Letta documents multiple mechanisms for autonomous background operation: an always-on App Server that hosts agents independent of any client session, headless mode for scripting/CI-CD integration, and a 'dreaming' feature that runs background subagents to consolidate memory 'without interrupting your active work.' Stateful agents persist and can be resumed from anywhere, supporting long-running autonomous processes. Missing for 10: explicit cron-like scheduling/trigger configuration beyond dreaming triggers, and independent/hands-on evidence corroborating that background automations run reliably in production.
